item.text: {"search_note":"I found good evidence on bureaucratic and economic technocracy, and good counterevidence on politicized information control and patronage. I did not find equally strong 2024 evidence of a clear personnel pattern in the military or internal-security chain that would let me say more than “some indirect support, but not a decisive record” not just capable neutral executors.","question_ids":["8B.4"]},{"title":"HRW warned that state control over the digital ecosystem and misuse of government-held data could tilt the playing field toward 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-spends-billions-on-jobs-key-allies-in-first-budget-after-election/2187546/","summary":"This is strong evidence that political bargaining shaped speech against Muslims and minorities.","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"14 Aug 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/14/india-hate-speech-fueled-modis-election-campaign","summary":"This is indirect but relevant negative evidence, because it suggests Modi empowered
